usageNotes: Use this endpoint to read the node-level firewall log (iptables/nftables kernel log entries) for a specific Proxmox node. Requires the `Sys.Syslog` privilege on `/nodes/{node}`, so API tokens scoped below that path will be denied. Use `since`/`until` (UNIX epoch) to narrow the time window; without them the full log is returned, which can be large on busy nodes.

examples.summary: Fetch the last 50 firewall log entries from node pve1 since a recent timestamp

tips: Results are an array of objects with `n` (line number) and `t` (raw log text); parse `t` for IP, port, and action fields.
Use `start` + `limit` together for pagination through large log windows.
This endpoint reads the node firewall log only — for VM/CT firewall logs use the equivalent endpoint under `/nodes/{node}/qemu/{vmid}/firewall/log` or `/nodes/{node}/lxc/{vmid}/firewall/log`.
Log entries only appear if the firewall LOG rule action is configured; if the firewall is enabled but no LOG rules exist, the log will be empty.
